Commentary.Commentary: The Bangladesh bowlers will be pleased with their effort, especially after the start the Lankans got. Five of their seven bowlers contributed with a wicket at least with Rubel Hossain being the star. He ended with figures of 10-0-46-4. He was well supported by the Mustafizur who bowled very economically and deceived the batsmen with his cutters. The bowlers though will feel they have done their job and now the onus is on their batsmen as to how they will respond. Also, Shakib Al Hasan, has copped a blow on his left hand and so we aren't sure if he has recovered. Well, Bangladesh would hope that he has. Who will roar louder? The Tigers or the Lions? Join us for the fascinating second-half of the Tri-Series final...

After winning the toss and opting to bat, the away side lost Gunathilaka early but Kusal Mendis came out all guns blazing. He scored 28 off just 9 balls before playing a shot too many. Although, he ensured Sri Lanka got off to a flier, Tharanga and Dickwella then steadied the ship considerably. They could not keep up the scoring rate but stitched a vital 71-run stand before the latter departed. Chandimal, then came in next and built another stand with Tharanga who was knocked over (getting a few lives) after he reached a half ton. The Lankan skipper though couldn't accelerate but showed immense patience to take the team's total to a respectable one, considering the nature of the pitch.

Just 54 runs in the last 10 overs with the loss of 5 wickets, Sri Lanka have managed to crawl their way to 221. A total which they will be happy with as the wicket has variable bounce and is also very slow and sluggish in nature.

OUT! No, they can't! A wicket to finish, more importantly a dot. Full ball outside off, Chameera swings at it again but does not connect. Lakmal goes for a bye but Rahim underarms and hits the stumps. The square leg umpire straightaway gives it out. Just 2 from the last over and SRI LANKA FINISH WITH 221 ON THE BOARD!
Fuller outside off, Lakmal mistimes it down towards long on for a run. Two runs till now from the last over, there is one ball to go. Can Sri Lanka find a boundary?
Short and wide outside off, Lakmal tries to pull but connects with thin air.
Fuller on off, driven down to long on for a run.
Dushmantha Chameera is the last man in.

OUT! A dot and now a wicket to follow! Full and straight on the stumps, Madushanka tries to go over mid-wicket but misses completely and it knocks the middle stump out. A short outing with the bat for the debutant and Rubel gets his fourth.
DOT TO START! A full ball outside off, the batsman swings but misses.
Good length on off, played back to the bowler. Just 4 from the penultimate over. Excellent!
Fuller in length on off, driven down to mid on for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Suranga Lakmal walks out at no. 10.
OUT! A soft dismissal! Mustafizur bowls a cutter on off, Akila tries to go over covers. A very difficult shot to a ball coming in. He mistimes it and gives an easy catch to Mithun at covers.
The batsman gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Another one on the pads, Akila misses the flick. The ball hits the pads and rolls towards square leg for a leg bye. There was a muted appeal but nothing from the umpire.

FOUR! EDGED BUT RUNS! Full outside off, Madushanka throws the kitchen sink at it but gets an outside edge through short third man and the ball races away. 16 runs from the over, a big one for Sri Lanka.
Works it through the leg side for a run.
MAIDEN ODI RUN FOR MADUSHANKA! The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Shehan Madushanka makes his way out.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! You miss and I hit mate! Rubel bowls it very full on the stumps, Chandimal goes for a big heave across the line but misses. The ball cannons into the middle stump and Chandimal has to make the long walk back. He falls five short of his fifty. He played the anchoring role but perishes at the wrong time.
A low full toss, Chandimal gets it off the toe end straight down the ground for a couple. 10 from the first 2 balls.
Once again, just a single off the Free Hit. Full ball on the stumps, Akila digs it out towards mid-wicket for a single.

NO BALL and a SIX to add salt to the wound! Another high full toss on middle, Akila this time takes full toll of it as he sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence. 7 runs without a ball being bowled! Are we in for a big over here? Free Hit coming up.
Rubel Hossain is back into the attack.
Just a single off the free hit! A short ball around off, Akila mistimes it towards mid on for a run.
A high bouncer, very high. A beamer you can say, not intentional though. Akila ducks under it and the umpire calls it a no ball.
The batsman gets a bottom edge! The keeper gathers it on the bounce.
A big heave, takes the top edge and once again lands in no man's land. How many times have we seen this today? A couple taken by the batsmen.
Another cutter on middle, Akila goes for the big heave but misses it.
Length on off, guided towards point for a run.
Mustafizur who is back into the attack, bowls a full ball outside off. Chandimal times it nicely through extra cover for a couple.
The batsman gets a leading edge on that one.
FOUR! A much-needed one! It has come after 77 deliveries! A length ball around off, Akila makes room and slaps it over mid off and fetches himself a boundary.

Fuller in length on off, pushed to covers. Chandimal wants a run and sets off for it but is sent back. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Though, replays later on show that the dive would have saved Chandimal there had the fielder hit.

Another full ball on the pads, Dinesh fails to flick to get hit on the pads and it rolls towards point. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The batsmen take a run. Replays later on show there was an inside edge there.
WIDE! Down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
Fuller in length driven through covers for a run.
On a length around off, defended towards point for a run.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back into the attack.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.

Again an overthrow! Another in dipper around off, Chandimal gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball goes towards point and the batsmen complete an easy run. The fielder there though, once again has a needless shy and hits again. The ball deflects away from the fielder backing up at mid on and they take an extra run.
On a length around off, Akila plays it towards point for a run.
Akila Dananjaya walks out at no. 8.

OUT! No he has not edged it and it is umpire's call! Gunaratne is given his marching orders and another one bites the dust here! Rubel bowls an inswinger around middle, it is on the fuller side. Asela once again walks across and tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Rubel appeals and the umpire agrees. Asela walks up to his skipper and has a chat before opting for the DRS. Replays roll in and it shows no inside edge but is is clipping the leg stump. The umpire's call stays but Sri Lanka don't lose a review.
Another LBW given! Asela though reviews but it looks out, unless he has edged it.
Shorter in length, hurries onto the batsman. Chandimal mistimes his pull to long on for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Dinesh cuts it to point.
Again bowls a cutter on leg stump, it spins away after pitching. Chandimal misses the flick and the ball hits the pads and goes down towards third man for a leg bye.
Back of a length on off, taps it towards point for a quick run.
On a length around off, played to point.

An overthrow! Chandimal guides the ball towards point who has a needless shy at the non-striker's end. He hits bull's eye but the batsman never left his crease. The ball deflects towards mid off and the batsmen go for the run this time. Mustafizur rushes to the ball, picks it up and has a shy at the other end but misses. A run added. Replays later on show Gunaratne was in even if the Fizz had hit.
On the stumps, defended.
Shorter in length outside off, Chandimal cuts it to point.
Length around off, drops it down towards cover for a run.

CAUGHT? No, it was off the pads. Rubel bowls a length ball around off, it shapes back in. Chandimal misses the flick to get hit high on the pad. The ball goes towards Rahim who dives and takes it. The players appeal for caught behind but the umpire shakes his head.
Length on off, taps it towards cover for a run.
Back of a length on off, punched through mid off for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller on middle, flicked through mid on for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. End of another tight over! 8 overs to go, Sri Lanka need to get a move on here.
Shorter in length on off, defended off the back foot.
Shortish around leg, Chandimal tries to pull but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Pitching outside leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Walks across and flicks it through square leg for a run.

Ohkay! Shakib Al Hasan is down on the ground after his previous effort in the field. He might have injured his bowling hand, his left hand as he fell right on it. Not a good news, not a good news for Bangladesh. He is now seen walking off the field.

On a length around off, Chandimal pushes it towards cover. He calls for a run but then refuses as he sees Shakib coming towards the ball. The fielder dives over it and hence, the batsmen eventually get a run.
Another length ball on off, Gunaratne defends it towards point. A dot to end the 41st over.
On a length around off, Asela guides it to point.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Back of a length on off, defended.
Shorter in length on middle, Chandimal mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring now.
Worked against the angle towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Fuller in length on off, pushed through covers for a run.
On a length around off, Asela defends it.

How has that missed the stumps? Woah! Gunaratne walks across exposing all his stumps. The Fizz once again bowls a cutter around off, which pitches and spins away. Asela tries to flick but misses and the ball goes agonizingly past the off pole. Mustafizur can't believe it but he has to.
Length ball angling across the off stump. Asela tries to defend but gets beaten.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a run.

Good length on off, Chandimal tries to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and goes towards the keeper. Gunaratne calls for a run and makes it in even though Rahim kicks the ball onto the stumps.
Bangladesh have their tales up as they have stopped the run flow and have also chipped away at the wickets. Will they restrict Sri Lanka below 250?
Asela Gunaratne walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rubel strikes! The short ball does the trick. He bowls a bumper, a quick one on middle. Perera who was batting on 2 after facing 10 balls, tries to break the shackles. He clears his front leg and tries to pull it. The ball takes the top edge and goes towards mid-wicket where Tamim positions himself under it and takes a nice easy catch. Two quick wickets for Bangladesh and this is a big one, as Thisara can be very dangerous towards the end.

A huge appeal but not given! A fuller length swinging in again, Chandimal is once again beaten as he tries to flick. The ball hits him on the pads, the players appeal and the umpire shakes his head. The ball rolls down towards third man for a leg bye. Replays later on show it was missing leg. A good decision by the umpire.
Length delivery outside off, Chandimal tries to cut but is beaten.
Fuller in length on off, driven to mid off.
Another bumper on middle, Perera evades it.
Bouncer! Thisara ducks under it.
On middle, driven down to long on for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Fuller on off, angling across. Chandimal defends it.
Back of a length on off, Perera pushes it through cover-point for an easy run.

Cut Chandimal into half! Lovely bowling! On a length around off, it shapes back in late. Chandimal fails to account for the movement as he tries to defend. The ball beats him on the inside and strangely bounces over the stumps. I write strangely because this is a wicket where the ball is keeping low and this one goes over.
Length around off, pushed towards covers.
Gets off the mark with a single towards point.
Good length on off, Thisara keeps it out.
Short and pulled with brute force towards the square leg fielder who does well to stop it.
Starts off with a full ball angling into the batsman. Chandimal flicks it through square leg for a run.
Rubel Hossain is back on.
Just behind a length on middle, Perera pushes it to mid on.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Back of a length on off, defended.
Thisara Perera walks out to the middle.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Fifty ODI wickets for Rahman! He is the fastest to reach that milestone for Bangladesh. Take a bow, young man! He bowls it shorter around off, it's the cutter again. Tharanga goes for the pull but is beaten by the low bounce and the slowness on the ball. It hits the outer part of the off stump and that is it for the Lankan opener. Mustafizur is all smiles and Tharanga's luck runs out. Nevertheless, a good innings by him comes to an end but Sri Lanka would have loved it if he would have stayed till the end. End of the 45-run stand and Bangladesh will now look to capitalize.

NOT OUT! It is missing the leg pole! Excellent use of technology by Tharanga. Mustafizur bowls a full ball around middle, which tails back in very late. Tharanga cannot adjust to the movement as he misses his flick and is rapped on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Tharanga goes up to his skipper and after a chat, he reviews. There is no inside edge but the ball is shown to be missing the leg stump. Tharanga will continue his innings as the on-field decision has to be overturned.
HOWZZAT? The umpire raises the dreaded finger. Tharanga has been given out but after a chat with his partner, he reviews. Looks close.
Fuller on the pads, Chandimal flicks it towards wide mid on for a quick single.
Time for Drinks!

As I say that they will accelerate, Tharanga tries to go big with a flick shot but once again is early into the shot as it is the slower one. It balloons in the air and once again falls in an area where there is no fielder. Tharanga's luck continues. It might be his day today as he has been dropped twice and even his skiers are not going to hand. Ride on Tharanga! Two added to the total.
Back of a length on off, Tharanga guides it to point.
Good length on off, Chandimal taps it towards cover-point for a quick run. These two are going along well here, they will now look to accelerate.
Fuller in length, driven to mid off.
On a length around off, defended.
On the pads, Upul misses his flick to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg for a leg bye.
Mohammad Saifuddin is brought back to bowl.
A very full ball outside off, Chandimal goes for a loose drive away from his body and gets beaten. Lucky he did not edge that one.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Around off, it goes off the outer half towards point for a run.
Another length ball on off, Chanidmal plays it to point.
Good length on off, defended.
Length ball outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack.
SIX! Innovation at its best! Positions himself early for the reverse sweep. Shakib slows it down. Chandimal waits for it and sends it over point for a biggie.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Floats it up on off, driven down to long off for a run.
Very full on the pads, Tharanga goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Comes down the track, Shakib sees that and shortens the length. Upul goes for the flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Works it around the corner for no runs.
Good length on off, the batsman defends it solidly.
Good length around off, Tharanga does what he has been doing all day, guides it down to third man for a run.

FOUR! Fifty for Tharanga and he gets there in style. His 37th half ton in ODIs. He has played well and also has had luck on his side. Sri Lanka will now hope for him to make it big. He pulls the length ball not off the middle, but connects well for it to race along the turf and cross the mid-wicket fence.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller on the pads, flicked down to fine leg for a run.
On the shorter side, angling into the batsman. Chandimal pulls it in the gap towards backward square leg for a brace.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Flatter and shorter, punches it through covers. Sweeper cover in the deep does really well to dive and stop the ball inside. Two taken by the batsmen.
Tosses it up on off, driven down to long off for a run.

In the air... lands in no man's land! The big shot was coming as there were some tight overs bowled. Shakib tosses it up on off, Chandimal goes for the slog sweep but gets a top edge towards mid-wicket where the fielder running back can't get to it. Two runs taken in the end. Luck favoring Lanka.
Tosses it up on off, turning back in. Tharanga works it around the corner for a run.
Sweeps it against the spin for a run.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a run.
Fullish on off, drives it straight to covers.
Back of a length on off, pushed to covers for a run.
Fuller in length on off, driven to covers.
Length ball angling away, Upul tries to put bat on it but gets beaten.
Floats it up on off, defended.
Shorter in length outside off, stays low. Chandimal chops it to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Floats it up on off, driven to the man at covers.
Shorter in length, whipped through mid-wicket to change strike.

In the air... but does not carry! A length ball on the pads, Tharanga tries to flick but closes the bat face early. He gets a leading edge towards square leg where there is no fielder placed. Upul is living dangerously here. They run one.
Good length on off, defended.
Stays low! Luckily for Tharanga it was not on the stumps. On a length around off, angling away. Tharanga tries to guide it down to third man but is beaten by the low bounce.
A low full toss outside off, Chandimal reaches out for it and hits it through cover-point for a single.
On a length around off, driven to covers. Two dots to start with.
Fuller and tailing back in. Chandimal flicks it to mid-wicket.
Rubel Hossain comes into the attack.
Dances down the track and drives it down to long off for a run.
Floats it up on off, Chandimal defends it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

DROPPED! Another reprieve for Tharanga! This too was not an easy one but should have been taken. He comes down the track and tries to go inside out, over covers. He does not get the desired elevation. The fielder there leaps and gets both his hands to it but can't hang on. A single results in the end.
Works it around the corner with the spin.
Flatter around off, Tharanga tries to make room to cut but the ball zips through and takes the edge and goes to short third man.
Fullish ball on off, driven down to mid off. Two dots to end the over, another tight one, just three of it.
On a length around off, Chandimal plays it back to the bowler.
Fuller on off, driven down to long on for a single.
Bowls it on the pads, too easy for Chandimal. He flicks it through square leg but there is a man in the deep. A single results.
Fullish on middle, tailing back in. Chandimal flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length ball around off, Tharanga opens the face of his bat and guides it down to third man to start the over with a single.
Takes a stride forward and blocks it out gently.
This time he works it wide of the man at mid on and crosses over.
Again Tharanga drives and finds the man in the same region.
On middle and off, pushed to mid on.

What was that? A dropped chance or a stumping? Shakib sees Chandimal giving the charge and hence slows it through the air and also drags his length back. The Lankan skipper gets an inside edge and Rahim behind the stumps fails to catch and also misses a stumping chance. The ball goes down to third man and a single taken. Chandimal survives a big scare.
Starts with a flighted ball around off, defended watchfully off the front foot.
Shakib Al Hasan is brought into the attack.
Angles it on the pads, Chandimal gets underway with a clip through mid-wicket. A successful over from Saifuddin.
Dinesh Chandimal walks out to the middle next.

OUT! A soft, soft dismissal. What was that from Dickwella? Saifuddin has his hands aloft as he provides a vital breakthrough. He lands it on a length around middle and leg and it gets a touch big on the batsman. Niroshan is too early into the shot as he looks to work it away on the leg side. The ball spoons off the leading edge and Sabbir Rahman at point takes an easy catch. The 71-run stand comes to an end as the Lankan keeper walks back after a good knock.
Good ball! Saifuddin slants it away on a length, Dickwella goes after it and is lucky not to edge that one.
Shakib Al Hasan is seen warming up.
This time he manages to run it down to third man for a single.
Beaten! Slower one, angling away and leaving Tharanga who tries to poke at it. It whizzes past the outside edge to Rahim who takes and appeals. Nothing from the umpire.
Slanted away on a length outside off, eased down to third man for a single.
Short and flat on off, slapped a bit square of the wicket on the off side. A single picked up.
FOUR! One bounce and into the fence she goes! Gets down to this loopy delivery does Dickwella and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. Good shot! Dickwella moves into the 40s.
Loopy delivery outside off, Dickwella looks to drive but can't get it past the cover fielder.
Flatter ball on the stumps, punched off the back foot back to the bowler.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated ball outside off, eased towards the cover fielder.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Ahead of a length outside off, punched towards cover off the back foot.

Edged and dropped! Tharanga gets a life! Saifuddin goes wide of the crease and slants it away on a fuller length outside off which leaves Tharanga. He looks to run it down but gets a faint edge which flies to the left of the keeper. Rahim dives full length to take it with his left hand but the ball doesn't stick in his mitts. How costly will this prove?
Length ball outside off, punched through the cover region for a single.

FOUR! Up and over! Gets a fuller delivery on off and with mid off inside the circle, Dickwella tries to take his chance. Lofts it down the ground. Didn't time it well but had enough legs to fetch himself a boundary.
Starts his spell with a fuller ball on off, Niroshan drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Mohammad Saifuddin comes on to bowl.
Drops it short and outside off, punched towards the long off fielder for a single.
Flicks it against the turn through square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, pushed towards the cover fielder.
Darts it on the pads, flicked towards mid on where Mortaza makes a half-stop and parries it to mid off. A single taken.
Very full on off, driven down to long off to rotate strike.
Goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slower through the air, around middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket for a single. Excellent spell from Mehidy Hasan. Bowled 10 overs on the trot and his figures read 10-0-53-1!
Quicker and flatter outside off, Niroshan punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Covers the line and blocks it out gently.
On middle and off, blocked off the front foot.
Comes down the track, is done in the flight but still manages ti keep it out.
Angles it in on middle and leg, Dickwella tries to flick it away but misses to get hit on the pads.
Loopy delivery outside off, driven once again towards the same region.
Makes a bit of room and pushes it into the cover region.
Loopy ball around middle and off, eased down to long on for one.
Almost yorks himself as Dickwella jams it out towards the cover fielder.
Fuller and fired on middle, driven down the ground for a single. Brings up the 50-run stand between the two. A good one for the Lankans.
Slider, coming in with the arm, punched through extra cover for a single.
Flatter one outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.
Tharanga dances down the track and drills it through cover for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slows it through the air, lands it outside off, UT presses forward to defend but misses.
Slower but shorter in length outside off, dabbed towards short third man.
Shimmies down the track and eases it towards long off for one.
Change of ends for Mehidy Hasan.
Loopy ball around off, driven through cover for another single.
Short and outside off, punched towards long on for a single.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, at 78.3 kph, Dickwella nearly chips it past the non-striker down to long on for a single.
Sits back and with an angled bat, ND plays it to point.
Flighted ball outside off, the batsman comes down the track and pushes it towards cover-point.
Flatter one around middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single.
Drinks are on the field. Mahmudullah is brought into the attack to replace Mehidy Hasan.
Back of a length delivery, in the channel outside off, Upul runs it down to third man. The man in the deep does extremely well to stop it with a dive. UT will keep strike.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Tharanga chops it towards the point fielder.
Stands tall and steers it past point for a single.
Good length delivery, angling in off, cramps the batsman for room who gets an inside edge on the pads.
Fuller in length and angling in, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Pitches it up outside off, driven towards cover.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT! Clear inside edge! Darted around middle, Dickwella comes forward to defend but seems to have missed it. Gets hit on the pads and they appeal. The umpire raises his finger to the appeal. However, Dickwella straightaway reviews. First replay is enough to change the original decision.
Is there an inside edge? Niroshan Dickwella is quick to opt for the DRS. If there is no bat involved, Niroshan is a dead duck.
Floated ball outside off, driven through cover for a single.
Tossed up delivery around middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted delivery outside off, pushed towards the point.

NOT OUT! Missing the stumps! The on-field call stays! Rahman goes wide of the crease and hurls a cutter which deceives Tharanga and pings him on the front pad who misses his attempted flick shot. Huge appeal from the bowler but the umpire shakes his head. Bangladesh take the review. Ball Tracker takes a lot of time to generate and finally it comes and favours the batsman. It shows that the ball would have gone on to miss the stumps. Tharanga survives and the hosts lose their review.
Looks really close! Bangladesh have taken the review against Tharanga for an LBW...
Dickwella runs it down towards third man for a single.
Fuller ball on off, Dickwella checks his drive towards mid off.
Stays back and steers it off the back foot towards point.
Short of a length delivery outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Wide! Fuller and a bit too straight, Tharanga misses the flick.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Finally the first change of the day. Mustafizur Rahman replaces his skipper.
Floated ball around off, pushed off the front foot towards cover. Just one from the over. Good one from Hasan.
Short and quick on off, Tharanga winds up for the cut shot but it's too close to play that shot. Beaten!
Looks to defend again off the front foot but gets it off the high portion of the bat as the ball dies down on the pitch.
Goes wide of the crease and slows it through the air, lands it on middle and off, Tharanga prods forward in defense.
Darted on the pads, nudged towards short mid-wicket.
Good running! Flighted delivery outside off, tapped towards backward point and they take the fielder on. Complete the single in the end.

FOUR! How fine has he played that? Mortaza slants it on a length, a bit wide outside off, Tharanga waits for it and deftly runs it down towards third man for a boundary. All about using the pace of the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller in length on middle and leg, Tharanga pushes it off the inner half towards the left of the bowler.
On a length and just outside off, it stays a bit low too. Tharanga mistimes his punch towards point.
Mashrafe Mortaza goes around the wicket and angles it in on middle and leg, Dickwella works it with the angle in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Sprays it on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Tossed up ball on middle, bunted back to the bowler.
The batsman dances down the track. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Makes a bit of room and milks a single down to long off.
Flighted ball on off, driven towards the cover fielder.
FOUR! That's played really, really late! Short and outside off, Tharanga sits back and cuts it off the keeper's glove down to third man for a boundary.
Quicker one around off, Upul goes for the cut but gets beaten.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. The fielding side can relax a bit now because four fielders can now be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Fuller in length and jest around off, defended off the front foot towards the cover fielder. Just one from the over.
Steers it past the man at point to rotate strike.
Angling away on off, pushed towards point.
Slower one, lands it on off and it moves away. Tharanga is opened up as he has a tentative poke at it. Gets beaten on the outside edge which rolls on the bounce to Rahim behind.
Fuller on off, blocked watchfully.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot towards cover.

NOT OUT! Clipping the leg stump, umpire's call! Flatter and quicker through the air, it skids off the surface and pings Dickwella on the pads who tries to defend it off the back foot. Bangladesh roar in an appeal for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. Mehidy Hasan has a chat with his captain and they take the DRS. There is no bat involved and Hawk Eye shows it's pitching in line and would have gone on to clip the leg stump. The on-field call stays, Niroshan survives!
Has Mehidy Hasan got another one? A huge appeal for LBW against Dickwella is not given by the on-field umpire. After having a word with Mortaza, Bangladesh take the review...
Flatter one around middle and off, blocked solidly.
Goes back and with the turn Niroshan dabs it towards short third man.
Comes forward and defends it down.
FOUR! Very nicely done! Slows it through the air, it spins away from off, Dickwella waits for it and then at the last moment opens the face of the bat to get it past short third man for a boundary.
Floats it up outside off, swept towards the man at 45.
Dabs this length delivery through point for a single to keep strike.
Dickwella gets hit on the chest and was seen rubbing immediately. Has called for the physio who is out attending him...
Tucks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.

Tries to be cheeky! Good length delivery on middle and off, Dickwella sinks low and looks to play the paddle scoop but misses to get hit flush on the rib-cage. Mortaza keeps appealing for an LBW but the impact was the issue there.
FOUR! Another Lankan batsman who gets off the mark with a boundary! Fuller in length and on the pads, Dickwella walks across, picks it up and flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller in length and angling in, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on off, driven towards long off for a single.

FOUR! In the air... but through the gap! Mehidy tosses it around off, Tharanga makes room and chips it aerially but luckily for him, it goes through the gap at cover. Races away to the fence for a boundary.
Goes back and lets the ball spin away and then dabs it towards backward point.
Short and outside off, slapped hard but finds the man at cover-point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Niroshan Dickwella is the new man in.

OUT! Catching practice to Mahmudullah! One shot too many, says the commentator on air. Kusal Mendis what have you done? There was no need to play that shot. Mortaza is all pumped up. He lets out a huge roar and gives a sendoff to the batsman. He drops it short and angles it in from outside off, Kusal goes for the pull but mistimes it horribly towards mid on where Mahmudullah takes a dolly.
Shortish again outside off, punched nicely off the back foot. Another good stop this time at cover-point. A single results.
Superb stop, Mehidy! Short and outside off, Tharanga cuts it hard and it seemed like a boundary but Hasan at point dives full length to his right to make a classic stop.

FOUR! Easy peasy for Tharanga! Short ball, slower in pace and miles down the leg side. All Upul had to do was to get some bat on it. He shuffles across and helps it on its way down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Stays behind the line and offers a straight blade.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, poked towards point.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single. 24 off the over, a huge, huge one.
Quicker and fired around middle, worked towards long on for one. Sensible.

SIX! No stopping, Mendis! He has decided to go after the spinner. Sees the flight again, wears his dancing shoes on and smokes it over long on for another maximum. Third of the over already. What will Mehidy do now?

SIX! More runs! Kusal Mendis is off to a flier! Mehidy gives it more loop, lands it around middle and off, Mednis dances down the track and hits it cleanly down the ground for the second biggie of the over.
FOUR! Pulled away this time! The bowler drops it short on middle, too easy for any batsman. Mendis rocks back and pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket for a boundary.

SIX! What a hit! That certainly shows that the batsman is really confident! Mehidy gives it a nice loop, lands it full around middle and off. Kusal gets a long way across and slog sweeps it off the meat to send it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie all the way.
Slightly fuller on the pads, worked towards the man at square leg.
Stays back to this back of a length delivery and stabs it towards the off side.

That kicked off! Mashrafe drops it on a length and it rises off the deck to take Tharanga by surprise. Upul looks to fend it away by taking his eyes off the ball and wears it on the gloves. Rings his right hand immediately.
Angling in on middle and leg, nudged towards short mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Rides the bounce! Mortaza hurls it on a back of a length and serves a bit of width outside off, Mendis stands tall, gets on top of the bounce and cracks it through cover. Pierces the gap and gets off the mark in style.
A bit short and outside off, slapped straight to the man at point. Just a single and a wicket from the over.
Kusal Mendis walks out to bat next.

OUT! In the air... taken! Mehidy Hasan was always troubling Gunathilaka and finally removes him. He nicely floats it up around off, Gunathilaka dances down the track to go big but the ball turns away a touch. It lobs high up in the air off the outer half towards long off where Tamim Iqbal takes a sitter by coming across to his left. An early breakthrough for the hosts and they are really ecstatic.
Now bowls an arm ball, it keeps coming in, Gunathilaka goes back to cut but gets an inside edge on the pads.
That's a great delivery! Pitches it up around off, asks the batsman to come forward and then spins it away to beat the outside edge by a whisker.
Turning away from a length, Gunathilaka waits back and pushes it towards the point fielder.
Mehidy floats it up on off, the batsman makes room and drives it along the ground through cover for a single.
Tucks it towards mid-wicket and scampers through for a quick single. Mortaza gets to the ball and has a shy at his end but misses. Tidy stuff from the Bangladesh skipper.
Upul taps this length delivery in front of cover. Is off the blocks for a single but Danushka quickly sends him back as the fielder charges in.
Slants it on a back of a length, it shapes away a touch to beat Tharanga's back foot defense comprehensively.
Slightly fuller, just around that off stump line, Tharanga leans forward and drives it towards the cover fielder.
On a good length and slants it away this time, pushed off the back foot towards cover.
Starts off with a length delivery, curling back in on the pads, easily tucked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Mashrafe Mortaza will bowl with the second new ball.
Flighted ball on off, eased down to long off for a single. A good first over from Hasan.
Quicker one again, skids a bit off the deck, DG looks to cut but gets beaten.
That's a risky leave! Hasan bowls a quicker and flatter one around off, Danushka plants his front foot across and makes a leave. That wasn't far from kissing the off pole.
Nicely tossed up around off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Beaten! Excellent delivery! Tosses it up around off, Gunathilaka comes forward to defend but the ball spins away with some extra bounce to beat the outside edge of his bat.

FOUR! Sri Lanka are off to a perfect start! Mehidy Hasan starts with a loosener, drops it short and it's spinning away from off, Danushka camps back and packs a punch through extra cover to start the game with a boundary.

It's time to get underway, folks. The players and umpires have made their way out to the middle. The two openers are Danushka Gunathilaka and Upul Tharanga. Bangladesh to begin with Mehidy Hasan first up. A slip in place...

Team changes - Bangladesh have made three changes. Anamul Haque, Nasir Hossain and Abul Hasan make way for MOHAMMAD MITHUN, MOHAMMAD SAIFUDDIN AND MEHIDY HASAN. Sri Lanka have made one change. SHEHAN MADUSHANKA makes his international debut and comes in place of Lakshan Sandakan.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to bat.

Hello and a warm welcome for the final of the tri-series between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka in Dhaka. It was 1-1 between the two in the group stage with both the teams winning their games quite convincingly. But it all comes down to today's result as the winner takes it all. The thrashing that Sri Lanka gave to Bangladesh in their must-win encounter means that they have the momentum on their side. Can they replicate their performance or will Bangladesh roar back and take the trophy? Let us hope for an exciting game. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates...
